# Scene example fixtures

Copies of `examples/scene/scene_registration.json` and
`examples/scene/scene_stitching.json` from <https://github.com/ome/ngff-spec>
at commit `cf2d4e994981bc7a368c569b1622b32c6ab2aab1`: the `zarr.json`
documents of two scene groups at OME-Zarr 0.6, one stitching four tiles into
a world coordinate system, one registering two templates through a bijection
of displacement fields. Apart from a final newline, the files are
byte-identical to upstream.
